title: Twilio SendGrid API key: one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 42 vs contracted 43. Twin of "Twilio SendGrid API key: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
